engines.cascade: static HTML with the cascade resolved
engines.render: the page in a browser at 1440, 768 and 390

rulings: a number in a rule's rulings names the item, in their own order, of the thirteen contradictions between the sources ruled on 2026-10-24 before a rule took a side
changes: stagger-offset replaces the proposed stagger-total: the total's only source was a restricted skill held as a reference, so the rule is restated from an MIT source's offset band
home-ref-resolves is a reflex, not the proposed floor: a DESIGN.md reference is neither accessibility, honesty nor a layout that holds
overlay-transitioned is the sixth rule of the transitions.dev scanner, restated as the ruling of 2026-10-24 admits
sentence: each sentence is the one the practice's pages carry for the rule; J-123 S3 writes those pages with the sentence as written here

A control's boundary, its focus indicator and a meaningful graphic reach 3:1 against what is next to them.
The APCA contrast of text is reported beside the WCAG 2 ratio and never blocks.
Where the home declares a dark scheme, text contrast holds in both schemes.
